description: This PHP class 'TimeValue' provides functionality to convert various string representations of time into Excel or PHP date/time formats. It includes parsing logic, regex extraction, and methods to handle different return types based on user settings.

classes.name: TimeValue
classes.description: A utility class to parse time strings into Excel or PHP date/time formats.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string time representation into an Excel serial value, Unix timestamp, or PHP DateTime object based on configuration, supporting array inputs for batch processing.
